ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-1,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 28-G in the area bound by:

a line 660,19 feet south of and parallel to West 112" Street; a line 133.15 feet west of
and parallel to South Peoria Street; a line 597.09 feet south of and parallel to West 113°
Street; the east right-of-way line of the Pennsylvania Railroad; a northeasterly line
161.17 feet from a point 780.19 feet south of and parallel to 112" Street and 543.15 feet
west of and parallel to South Peoria Street to a point 627.19 feet south of and parallel to
112" Street and 473,15 feet west of and parallel to South Peoria Street; a line 133.1 feet
west of parallel to South Sangamon Street; and the alley next west of and parallet to
South Sangamon Street and extended where no alley exists,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
